name: note_memory
description: Personal notes and scratch pad. Agent can save, retrieve, and search structured notes that persist across conversations.

manual.overview: Use when you need persistent scratch notes across conversations—save context, decisions, or reminders for later retrieval.

input.title: project-notes
input.content: API key stored in keychain. Use /v1/translate.

examples.description: Search past notes for API key

tips: Use descriptive titles for easy search and retrieval
search finds notes by content; list shows all titles
Notes persist across sessions; delete when no longer needed
edge_cases: Very large note content may impact search performance
No sync—notes are local to this agent instance
